name: Turf War
description: 3-minute 4v4. Ink the most turf to win. No ranks.

name: Splat Zones
description: Control ink zone(s) to drain timer. First to 0 wins.

name: Tower Control
description: Ride the tower to checkpoints. Furthest distance wins.

name: Rainmaker
description: Carry the Rainmaker to enemy pedestal. Like capture-the-flag.

name: Clam Blitz
description: Collect clams, throw Power Clam into enemy basket. Basketball with clams.

name: Anarchy Battle (Series)
description: Solo queue ranked. Win 5 before losing 3 to earn series points and rank up from C- to S+.

name: Anarchy Battle (Open)
description: Play solo or with friends, earn Anarchy Power per rotation.

name: X Battle
description: Unlocks after reaching S+ . 4v4 elite ladder with X Power per mode/division. +75 X Power for a 3-0 like yours!

name: Private Battle
description: Custom lobbies, all modes/maps, password protected.

name: Salmon Run Next Wave
description: 4-player PvE. Collect Golden Eggs vs Salmonids across waves. Shifts rotate maps/weapons.

name: Big Run
description: Salmon Run invasion of a Turf War stage. Limited-time high scores.

name: Splatfest
description: Weekend 3-team Turf War festival: Open + Pro + Tricolor. Deep Cut hosts.

name: Challenge / Event Battle
description: Limited-time special rules (e.g. Foggy Notion, Tower Control with faster towers).
